messages.snippet: Hi Dan, Just confirming the revised collection slot for the three pallets is Thursday between 14:00
messages.subject: Pallet collection Thursday - revised slot
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Dan,

Just confirming the revised collection slot for the three pallets is Thursday between 14:00 and 16:00 at the Wakefield depot, not the morning as first booked. Can you make sure someone's on the loading bay?

Cheers,
Karen

(Sorry if this isn't you - I have a Tom G in my contacts and may have picked the wrong one!)
